\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}

\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\newtheorem{definition}{Definition}[section]

\begin{document}

\section{First section}\label{sec:first}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:first}
First theorem.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:first}
Shared theorem counter.
\end{lemma}

\begin{definition}\label{def:first}
Independent definition counter.
\end{definition}

\subsection{First subsection}\label{subsec:first}

\begin{theorem}\label{thm:after-subsection}
The section-based theorem counter does not reset here.
\end{theorem}

\section{Second section}\label{sec:second}

\begin{lemma}\label{lem:second}
The shared counter resets with the section.
\end{lemma}

\begin{definition}\label{def:second}
The definition counter also resets with the section.
\end{definition}

\end{document}
